summary:
ASTRONOVA: Astronaut Explorer is an interactive educational website designed to help students discover the fascinating world of human space exploration. The project provides an engaging introduction to astronaut life, responsibilities, space research, microgravity, daily routines, astronaut preparation and major space missions.

The website is divided into interactive learning sections, including What Does an Astronaut Do?, Life in Space, Train Like a Space Explorer, Explore Major Space Milestones and Frequently Asked Questions.

It includes an educational progress checklist that allows learners to track their exploration of space-related topics. Through simple explanations, responsive web design and interactive elements, ASTRONOVA makes complex space concepts easier to understand.

The main objective is to promote scientific curiosity, STEM education and awareness about human spaceflight while inspiring the next generation of space explorers.
details:
ASTRONOVA is a web-based educational platform developed to introduce learners to the science and experience of human space exploration.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

The website provides five main learning sections:

  1. About Astronauts: Explains the responsibilities of astronauts, including conducting scientific research, operating spacecraft and supporting Earth-based research.
  2. Life in Space: Introduces the daily routines of astronauts, including food, sleeping arrangements, exercise and living in a microgravity environment.
  3. Astronaut Training: Provides an educational explorer checklist covering the solar system, microgravity, teamwork, problem-solving and life aboard a space station. Learners can track their progress interactively.
  4. Space Missions: Introduces important milestones such as Vostok 1, Apollo 11, the International Space Station and Artemis I.
  5. Frequently Asked Questions: Answers common questions about floating in space, astronaut preparation and communication with Earth.

TECHNOLOGY USED:

  • HTML5 for website structure.
  • CSS3 for styling, responsive layouts and visual presentation.
  • JavaScript for interactive functionality.
  • Web browser for accessing the educational platform.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Responsive and user-friendly interface.
  • Interactive navigation.
  • Progress-tracking checklist.
  • Expandable FAQ section.
  • Educational information about human spaceflight.
  • Links to NASA educational and mission resources.

CREATIVITY AND INNOVATION:

The project transforms space-related information into an accessible digital learning experience. Instead of presenting information only through textbooks, it allows learners to explore different aspects of astronaut life through an organized and interactive website.

EXPECTED IMPACT:

ASTRONOVA aims to improve students' understanding of space science, encourage STEM learning, develop scientific curiosity and inspire young learners to explore careers in science, technology, engineering and space research.

The platform can be further developed with quizzes, virtual space-station tours, astronaut mission simulations and additional interactive learning activities.
